note: MEASURED NEGATIVE: the regulatory 'tier' does NOT track compartment depth — nuclear and membrane signalling genes have near-identical tier means (diff -0.039), and there are MORE TFs upstream (24%) than downstream (8%), the opposite of a membrane->nucleus flow. So there is NO directional ladder. What IS delivered: a per-pathway compartment LAYOUT from localization (~100% coverage). Proteins are multi-compartment (source is not primacy-ordered) so each is counted in EVERY layer it's annotated in — a PROFILE/occupancy view + per-layer gene lists, NOT a route and NOT a phenotype predictor.
